authorial_rules: minimal contextual HUD
realtime no-next-button dialogue
white rounded dialogue bubble/medium gray normal text/light orange important text
NPC name on hover only
terrain relevance through stamina/load but no body balance
variable map scale and streaming phases
universal physical Ground Loot
Auto Pickup ON/OFF
pickup maximum distance 0.5m
icons by item type/category
stamina is a soft-yellow radial circle beside player and fully hides when full/inactive
exactly 2 weapon quick slots, one active at a time
weapon switching via keys 1/2 and unmodified mouse wheel
camera zoom via held configurable modifier + mouse wheel
mouse wheel is contextual and becomes UI scroll when a menu consumes it
inventory and all HUD share white rounded clean-console visual language with rounded legible text
shallow rivers can be crossed by player/NPC/animal and vehicles when depth allows; stronger current costs more stamina for living actors
deep water uses swimming for player/NPC/animal with higher stamina drain; zero stamina in water can cause defeat after a short gameplay-derived grace window
ordinary vehicles use traction/speed penalty in shallow water and are blocked from deep water unless future water-capable vehicle rules exist
without Bag the base inventory is smaller; equipped Bag is a real container that holds carried items
equipped quick-slot weapons plus equipped armor/clothes remain with owner on death
quest/critical unique items are protected from permanent loss
individual Ground Loot in water lasts 15 minutes; dropped Bag floats 30 minutes; land Bag persists until recovered
player may recover NPC Bag while original property ownership remains; NPC automatic theft is disabled
stage15_policy_note: Stage15 sealed historical no-loss policy remains unchanged; Stage16A authorial bag-drop policy is authoritative for Stage16 vertical slice.
carry_routing_note: Effective carried load includes base inventory plus equipped Bag; terrain/water stamina uses this combined weight.
economy_routing_note: Stage16A vendor BUY/SELL transfers items through the effective Bag/base inventory owner while currency wallet remains attached to the actor profile.
